labels.text: Schematic, approximately to scale (OpenStreetMap positions); not a survey plan

areas.name: Terminal 2 · A gates (main building)
areas.description: Main T2 building: departures lounge and A gates. Arriving passengers are kept apart from departing passengers (arrivals level / corridors, T2 arrivals tour); connecting passengers follow the purple Flight Connections signs and are screened again.

areas.name: Terminal 2 · B gates (satellite)
areas.description: T2B satellite, reached from T2A through a subway (lift → subway → lift), about 15 min walk (Heathrow T2 tour).

areas.name: Terminal 3
areas.description: T3 departures lounge with its piers (pier list not published in a source read; Pier 6 built 2006). Arrivals use a separate arrivals walkway that splits towards Flight Connections or passport control (T3 arrivals tour).

areas.name: Terminal 4
areas.description: T4, south of the southern runway; gates "very close to the check-in and security halls" (Wikipedia). El Al, Air France / KLM, Qatar and others (terminal finder). Its Flight Connections layout is not described in any source read.
areas.notes: arrivals: segregated is inferred from the airport-wide design (international arrivals are kept apart from departures at every terminal toured).

areas.name: Terminal 5 · A gates (main building)
areas.description: T5 main building: departures lounge and A gates (A1–A23, "Gates 10–23" signed on Level 2). The Transit train to the B and C gates starts here.

areas.name: Terminal 5 · B gates (satellite)
areas.description: T5B satellite (B32–B48), reached by the airside Transit train or a pedestrian walkway below it.

areas.name: Terminal 5 · C gates (satellite)
areas.description: T5C satellite (C52–C66), the last Transit station.

areas.name: Terminal 2 · UK & Ireland flights (in the common departure lounge)
areas.description: Logical area for UK domestic, Ireland and Isle of Man flights at T2 (Aer Lingus, Loganair: terminal finder). They leave from the common departure lounge; which gates they use is not known, so this area has no gate list. Passengers arriving from abroad reach it only through UK immigration and the biometric check (Heathrow).

intraWalk.note: gates of the UK & Ireland flights in T2 are not known

areas.name: Terminal 5 · UK & Ireland flights (in the common departure lounge)
areas.description: Logical area for BA UK domestic, Ireland and Channel Islands flights at T5 (terminal finder: ABZ, BHD, EDI, GLA, INV, MAN, NCL, JER, GCI, DUB). Gates not known. Reached from an international arrival only through UK immigration and the biometric check.

areas.name: Terminal 2 · Flight Connections (location not published)
areas.description: Where T2 connecting passengers are screened again and the connections buses leave. Exists by the airport-wide rule (purple Flight Connections signs, all connections re-screened); its position and layout are not described in any source read.

areas.name: Terminal 3 · Flight Connections Centre and connections bus area
areas.description: Arrivals corridor → Flight Connections Centre → information sign → lifts / escalator down to the connections shuttle area (Heathrow T3 → T5 tour).
areas.notes: Where T3 → T3 connecting passengers are screened is not shown in the tour (assumed: in the Flight Connections Centre).

areas.name: Terminal 4 · Flight Connections (not described in any source)
areas.description: Placeholder for the T4 connections area: the airport-wide rule says it exists (all connections re-screened, bus between terminals), but no tour, map or description of it was readable (maps.heathrow.com is a JS app).

areas.name: Terminal 5 · Flight Connections area (bus arrival Level 0 → security Level 3)
areas.description: Connections bus arrival on Level 0 → walkway to Level 2 → connections information display ("Passengers connecting to Terminals 2, 3 or 4 should follow the signs to the transfer buses") → pre-security area with airline desks → security eGates on Level 3 → International Departures Lounge (Heathrow T3 → T5 tour).

gateGroups.label: T2 A1–A26
gateGroups.notes: Signed as "A1"…"A26"; prefixed "T2 " here because T5 also has A gates. Range from Wikipedia ("concourse A, gates 1–26"); OpenStreetMap shows A16–A26 only. The official map is a JS app (owner capture).

gateGroups.label: T2 B28–B49
gateGroups.notes: Signed "B28"…"B49" (prefix "T2 " here: T5 has B gates too). Wikipedia range; OpenStreetMap shows B31–B49.

gateGroups.label: T3 gates (as mapped)
gateGroups.notes: Numbered gates as mapped in OpenStreetMap with terminal=3 (Heathrow names "Gate 7" at T3). Numbers only; prefixed "T3 " (T4 also has a Gate 7). Pier membership not established. Not every gate may be listed.

gateGroups.label: T4 gates (only those Heathrow names)
gateGroups.notes: PARTIAL: only the gates named on Heathrow's assistance page ("Near Gate 7", "By Gate 11A"). The full T4 gate list is unknown: OpenStreetMap numbers T4 positions 401–432, which are stand numbers. A secondary site claims gates 1–21 plus 22–25 on "Victor Pier" (not used). Owner capture: maps.heathrow.com.

gateGroups.label: T5 A1–A23
gateGroups.notes: Signed "A1"…"A23" (prefix "T5 " here: T2 has A gates too). Heathrow signs "Gates 10–23" on Level 2 and names A2, Gate 12, Gate 21.

gateGroups.label: T5 A4, A10 (coaching)
gateGroups.notes: Wikipedia: "gates A4 and A10 which are coaching gates"; OpenStreetMap shows A10a–e. Some contact gates can also be used for coaching (Wikipedia).

gateGroups.label: T5 B32–B48
gateGroups.notes: B32–B48 (Wikipedia); OpenStreetMap has B32–B39 and B42–B48 (no B40/B41 mapped, so they are left out). Heathrow names B35.

gateGroups.label: T5 C52–C66
gateGroups.notes: C52–C66 (Wikipedia); OpenStreetMap has C52–C57 and C61–C66 (C58–C60 not mapped, left out). Heathrow names C53.

rules.text: All connecting passengers are screened again at Heathrow, whatever the origin (no one-stop security list). Liquids up to 2 l and large electrical items may stay in the cabin bag when connecting. A boarding pass is not required at connections security (an itinerary is enough, "may take a little longer").

One Stop Security trial (2025): passengers from Dallas–Fort Worth (American) and Atlanta (Delta) connecting at T3 or T5 skip the re-screening. Its 2026 status is not confirmed, so the model applies transfer security to them too (conservative; the time is slightly overstated for them).

Zones: international (every gate area) and UK & Ireland (domestic: UK, Ireland, Channel Islands, Isle of Man flights, logical areas in the common departure lounges of T2 and T5). International → domestic passes UK immigration before security plus a facial biometric check; domestic → international has no passport control (no UK exit control). Crown Dependency handling is inferred from the Common Travel Area.

Passing UK border control (self-transfer, leaving the airport, international → domestic) needs the right to enter: an ETA or visa for most nationalities (Israel, USA and EU/EEA/Swiss citizens are ETA nationals). An airside connection that does not pass border control needs no ETA. Never asserted to a traveller: the extension only warns.

UK eGates: British, EU/EEA/Swiss (with digital status) and Australia, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore, South Korea and USA passports (age 8+); Israeli passports use the staffed desks (not on the list).

Between terminals the connection is a free airside Flight Connections bus "every 10 minutes" (BA: every 6–10 minutes). Hours, boarding points and ride times are not published, except Heathrow's 10-min T3 → T5 tour step; other pairs use derived ride times.

Minimum connection times: Heathrow publishes none ("your airline will generally quote a minimum connection time"). BA material (search excerpt, undated) quotes about 90 min T3 → T5. Not used as a rule.

Through-checked bags are transferred by the airline; separately booked flights: collect the bags, exit through arrivals and check in again (self-connection = arrival + departure). Heathrow mentions no self-connection bag service.
Customs: passed after baggage reclaim on the way out (self-transfer); not on airside connections.

Gates are announced about 45 min before departure and shown only after security; Flight Connections screens show the terminal. The flight-data feed carries no LHR gates (0 %, measured 2026-11-02), so predictions are at terminal level only.
No scheduled departures 22:40–06:00 and no scheduled arrivals 22:55–05:05 (night quota period 23:30–06:00).

Terminal by airline (Heathrow terminal finder): BA T5 and T3 (37 destinations, by destination), El Al T4, BA Tel Aviv T5, Virgin Atlantic / American / Delta T3, Star Alliance T2, Air France / KLM / Qatar T4. 2028 moves (Delta, Finnair, JAL → T4; LATAM → T2; China Southern → T5) are provisional (secondary sources).

Deadlines: BA boarding gate at least 20 min before departure (Heathrow quoting BA); BA (excerpt): clear Flight Connections and security at least 35 min before departure; BA check-in / bag drop 45 min short-haul, 60 min long-haul (secondary excerpt); Virgin Atlantic check-in closes 60 min before departure.
